name: Quick Pill 5.5.4
changelog: Feature: Dust dissolve animation — deleting a task, a quick note or a notification now crumbles the row into dust instead of blinking it away.
Feature: iOS-style notification chime — a soft two-note bell for incoming notifications with 5 selectable presets, a master toggle and a volume slider (Settings → Sound & Alerts).
Fix: Auto-updater now waits until Quick Pill fully exits before the installer runs, installs silently and relaunches the new version — the app no longer stays open after an update.
Fix: Failed downloads no longer report a successful installation, and the update manifest is fetched from the release repository that actually hosts the installer.
Polish: Notification sound and dust effects are enabled for the Electron build with a relaxed autoplay policy so the chime always plays.
